title: SDK Bridgeflow: hybrid streaming + batched cursor adapters for embeddings & rerank (parity across Python/TypeScript/Go)
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Implement a cross-SDK adapter (Bridgeflow) that exposes a single developer-facing primitive for low-latency streaming responses and efficient batched pagination for embeddings and reranking endpoints. Goals: 1) API parity across Python/TS/Go for streaming + paginated batch reads, 2) backpressure-aware client iterators that switch to batched mode when throughput or token budgets demand it, 3) standardized retry/backoff policies with idempotency guidance for rerank requests, and 4) multiple examples demonstrating hybrid mode and migration path from current iterator implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Public SDK APIs in Python/TS/Go expose the same Bridgeflow types: .stream(), .pages(batch_size), and .hybrid(mode) documented
Streaming iterators handle partial-batch assembly and deliver stable event order under transient retries
Cursor-based pagination is supported: token preserved across SDKs and can be resumed after transient errors
Retry/backoff behavior is configurable per-client and defaults to our recommended policy; retries for non-idempotent rerank calls require explicit opt-in
Comprehensive examples added: quickstart (low-latency streaming), bulk/throughput (batched pages), and hybrid (automatic mode switching) for each language
End-to-end tests in CI covering: ordering guarantees, resume-from-cursor, and integrated backpressure under artificial latency
